manifest.description: Mandarin practice for A1–A2 learners. When you stop, the coach asks why and you decide what changes.

home.eyebrow: For learners of Mandarin in Taiwan · A1–A2
home.hero_title: You did not fail. You stopped, and nobody showed you the way back.
home.hero_sub: Huayu Coach is a Mandarin practice app for international students in Taiwan. Short daily tasks, and when you get stuck, a coach that asks why and proposes a lighter plan. You decide.
home.note_pilot: Free during the pilot. No payment details needed.
home.problem_title: Most people do not quit because they are lazy
home.problem_p1: Life gets busy, the grammar gets hard, you get tired or distracted. You miss a few days. Then the plan feels too big to return to, and it is easier to stay away.
home.problem_p2: Huayu Coach is built for that moment. When you stop, it asks why instead of scolding you, and helps you restart with a plan that fits the week you are having.
home.how_intro: Four steps. You stay in control of every one.
home.step1_body: It finds your starting point, A1 or A2, so practice is not too easy or too hard.
home.step2_body: Each day you get a small set of practice questions, sized to the study time and the number of exercises in your plan. The question bank is still growing, so some questions come back for review.
home.step3_title: Tell us when you get stuck
home.step3_body: Press I'm stuck and choose why: too hard, no time, need a rest, or distracted. You may add a note. We never guess from your silence.
home.step4_body: The coach proposes up to three adjustments and shows the facts behind each one. Accept some, all or none.
home.reasons_title: Four reasons, four kinds of help
home.reasons_intro: Everyone stops for a different reason, so the suggestions are different too.
home.reason_too_hard_body: Fewer new grammar points and fewer exercises per day, and a short review of a topic you often get wrong, if your answers show one.
home.reason_no_time_body: Suggestions such as a shorter daily time (down to the minutes you really have), fewer exercises, and splitting practice into two sessions.
home.reason_need_rest_body: A day off. Nothing else is changed and nothing is held against you. You can also rest for longer from the Rest button at any time.
home.reason_distracted_body: Short focus blocks of 10 minutes and, if your plan is long enough, two shorter sessions instead of one.
home.reasons_foot: No suggestion adds study time. You may accept some, all or none, and you can always set any number yourself on the Plan page, higher or lower.
home.example_intro: Example with the default 30-minute plan. You say: it is too hard.
home.example_now: Your plan now: 5 new grammar points and 8 exercises a day.
home.example_s1: Suggestion 1: 2 new grammar points a day instead of 5.
home.example_s2: Suggestion 2: 5 exercises a day instead of 8.
home.example_choice: You pick one, both or neither. Until you confirm, your plan stays exactly as it is.
home.honest_p1: Rules decide every number. A rule engine reads your plan and your results and proposes at most three changes, each with its evidence. It is not an AI diagnosis.
home.honest_p2: AI wording is optional and off by default. If the operator switches it on and you agree separately, an AI provider chosen by the operator may write an extra explanation, shown above the fixed suggestions. It receives only study facts such as the reason code, plan numbers and counts, never your note, name or e-mail. It cannot change a suggestion or a number, and a reply with numbers that are not in the data is thrown away.
home.honest_p3: What you write in your own note is never sent to an AI provider.
home.honest_content_pending: Practice questions are being reviewed by teachers step by step. Some of the questions you will see have not been reviewed yet, so please tell us if something looks wrong.
home.honest_content_approved: Practice questions are reviewed by teachers, and only approved questions are shown.
home.honest_no_promise: We make no promise about exam results.
home.who_p1: Beginners at A1–A2 who are learning Mandarin in Taiwan, especially international students. The app speaks Tiếng Việt, 繁體中文 and English. The lessons are in Chinese. At this early stage many answer options and explanations are in Vietnamese or Chinese, and English explanations are still being added.
home.who_p2: If you already read Chinese easily, it is not for you yet. If you have a class, use Huayu Coach as a practice partner, not a replacement.
home.calm_2: No guilt messages when you miss a day.
home.calm_4: A Rest button that is always there.
home.final_title: Ready to restart at your own pace?
home.final_body: Create an account, take the short placement test and begin with a small task today.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.intro: Simple plans in New Taiwan dollars (NT$). Every plan includes everything.
pricing.pilot_body: While we test with the first students, every feature is free and we do not ask for any payment details.
pricing.planned_note: Nothing below is charged now. Prices may change before paid plans start, and we will e-mail you before any paid plan applies to you.
pricing.trial_body: A new account can use everything for {days} days. After that, choose a plan to keep learning.
pricing.include_1: A placement test to find your level (A1 or A2)
pricing.include_3: An I'm stuck coach: you tell us why, we propose, you decide
pricing.include_4: A Rest button, always free to use
pricing.include_5: Your progress and your plan history
pricing.include_6: Download or delete your data at any time, even after your access has ended
pricing.how_pay_body: For now payments are handled by hand: the operator records your payment and extends your access. There is no card or online payment yet. Instructions appear in Billing after you sign up.
pricing.no_renew_body: No. There is no automatic renewal. When your period ends, access to the lessons pauses until you renew. Your data is kept, and you can still rest, export or delete it.
pricing.stop_body: Nothing bad happens. There are no penalties and no streaks to lose. Tell the coach why, or just rest, and pick up again when you are ready.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This page explains in plain language what Huayu Coach stores about you, why, where, who can see it and how you stay in control. It describes what the app does today.
privacy.s1_intro: We store only what the app needs to work. An e-mail address and a password are needed to have an account; without them we cannot offer you the service. Everything else is optional or comes from what you do in the app.
privacy.s1_i1: Your account: e-mail address, a password hash (never the password itself), your name or nickname if you give one, language, time zone, level (A1 or A2), study mode and dates such as sign-up and last login. You also get a learner code. It is used in reports and in the note of a bank transfer, so it is a label for your account, not an anonymous one: the operator can link it to your e-mail while your account exists.
privacy.s1_i2: Your study answers: each practice question you answer, which option you picked, whether it was correct and when, and the status of your daily tasks (done or skipped).
privacy.s1_i3: Your plan and plan history: minutes per day, new grammar points, exercises and sessions, and every change to them: what changed, from what to what, and whether you or a suggestion you accepted made the change.
privacy.s1_i4: Interruptions (your “I'm stuck” reports): when you tell us you stopped, the reason you choose (too hard, no time, need rest, distracted), the optional note you write (up to 500 characters) and a snapshot of your plan and recent results at that moment. This only exists if you tell us. We never create it from inactivity.
privacy.s1_i5: Suggestions and your decisions: the adjustments the rule engine proposed, the facts behind them, which ones you accepted or declined, and the explanation shown to you.
privacy.s1_i6: Ratings: if you rate a suggestion, your scores from 1 to 5 for clarity, helpfulness and pressure, and your optional comment.
privacy.s1_i7: Consent records: which version of the data notice you agreed to and whether you allowed AI wording. Withdrawing consent is saved as a new record.
privacy.s1_i8: Subscription and payment records: your plan, status (trial or active), start and end dates and, if you pay, the amount, date, payment reference and any note the operator wrote.
privacy.s1_i9: Password reset: a one-way hash of the reset link and its expiry time, never the link itself. Each link works once. The e-mail with the link is sent through the operator's mail server.
privacy.s1_i10: Technical data: the cookies described below. The server logs keep only start-up lines and error messages: there is no line for each page you visit and no IP address. The app also keeps your IP address in memory for a short time to slow down abuse. That is not part of your learning record.
privacy.s1_i11: Admin log: when an administrator acts on your account (for example gives you days of access or records a payment), a short entry notes the action, the date and your learner code. It can include a short note the administrator typed. Administrators can read this log, and the entries about your account are in your data export.
privacy.s1_foot: We do not sell your data and we do not use it for advertising.
privacy.s2_p1: In a SQLite database file on the operator's own server. There is no separate analytics service and no advertising network.
privacy.s2_p2: The operator makes daily backup copies of that database. By default the last 14 daily copies are kept, so a copy can be up to 14 days old when it is replaced. Copies stored off the server are the operator's responsibility.
privacy.s3_p1: You can see your own data. The operator and staff with an admin or teacher role can open the admin area to run and support the service. Administrators can see, for each learner, the e-mail address next to the learner code, level, plan numbers, subscription and payment records (including any note the operator wrote), and the reasons you chose when you pressed I'm stuck, with their dates. The admin pages do not show the free-text note you write there. Teachers see the question bank only, no learner data. The operator, who runs the server, can also reach the database itself. Actions in the admin area are written to an audit log.
privacy.s3_p2: If the operator has set up a mail server, your e-mail address and the e-mails we send you, such as a password reset, pass through it. The operator chooses and runs that mail server. If there is none, a password-reset e-mail is only written to a file on the server, and that file stays there when you delete your account until the operator deletes it by hand.
privacy.s4_p1: AI wording is off by default: the explanation of a suggestion is written from fixed templates. The operator may switch it on and choose an AI provider (the app supports OpenAI, Anthropic and compatible services). Only if you also give a separate consent (the optional tick-box in onboarding, or the switch in Settings) may the app ask that provider to write an extra explanation, which is shown above the fixed suggestions.
privacy.s4_p2: What is sent: study facts only, such as the reason code (for example too hard), your current plan numbers, the proposed adjustments and the facts behind them, for instance how many answers were correct or the names of grammar topics you often got wrong. These facts carry no name or e-mail address.
privacy.s4_p3: What is never sent: your name, your e-mail address, your password or the free-text note you wrote.
privacy.s4_p4: The AI cannot decide or change any suggestion or number: the rule engine does that, and only the suggestions you tick are applied. The program discards a reply that contains a number that is not in the data. It cannot check the rest of the wording, so if the AI text and the list of suggestions ever differ, the list is what counts. The provider may process data outside Taiwan. You can withdraw your consent in Settings at any time, and the app keeps working the same way.
privacy.s4_on: Right now on this service: AI wording is switched on, and is only used for learners who gave consent.
privacy.s4_off: Right now on this service: AI wording is switched off. No study data is sent to any AI provider.
privacy.s5_p1: We use only the cookies needed to run the site: a login session (up to 30 days), a security token against forged requests, a short-lived message cookie (about one minute) and your language choice (one year). We use no advertising or tracking cookies.
privacy.s6_i1: Export: in Settings you can download a copy of your data as one file. It includes the admin-log entries about your account.
privacy.s6_i2: Delete: in Settings you can delete your account and everything you produced, including answers, plan, interruptions, ratings, consents and subscriptions. This cannot be undone. A little remains, as described under “How long we keep it”.
privacy.s6_i3: Correct: you can change your name, language and plan in the app, or ask us.
privacy.s6_i4: Rest: you can pause at any time with the Rest button. You never have to give a reason.
privacy.s6_i5: AI wording: you can withdraw your consent in Settings at any time.
privacy.s6_pdpa: Under Taiwan's Personal Data Protection Act (個人資料保護法) you may ask to view, copy, correct, stop the use of or delete your personal data. Use the tools above; for anything else, use the contact details on this page.
privacy.s7_p1: We keep your data while your account exists, so your plan and history stay available. We do not currently delete inactive accounts automatically.
privacy.s7_p2: When you delete your account, everything that belongs to you is removed from the live database: your account, answers, plan, interruptions, suggestions, ratings, consents and subscriptions. Two kinds of record stay. Payment records, if you ever paid, are kept for bookkeeping, detached from you and with their note removed. The admin log keeps a minimal entry for each action an administrator took on your account (the kind of action and its dates), filed under your learner code, which then belongs to no account; any note an administrator typed is removed. One more entry records that an account was deleted, without the code.
privacy.s7_p3: A deleted row can still leave old bytes inside the SQLite file until new data overwrites them. Backup copies are made daily and the last 14 are kept, so deleted data can remain in a backup for up to 14 days. If the operator restores a backup, an account deleted after that backup was made can come back until it is deleted again. Copies the operator stores off the server are the operator's responsibility. Server logs hold no line per visit, are rotated by size (at most 5 files of 10 MB for each of the app and the web server) and are lost when the service is rebuilt.
privacy.s8_p1: Passwords are stored as Argon2id hashes. Connections use HTTPS. Forms are protected against forged requests and login attempts are limited. No system is perfectly secure. If a breach affects you, we will tell you as the law requires.
privacy.s9_p1: If this policy changes in a way that matters, we will update this page and e-mail you before the change applies to you.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: These are the rules for using Huayu Coach. We kept them short and plain. By creating an account you agree to them.
terms.s1_p1: Huayu Coach is a practice and planning tool for Mandarin learners at A1–A2. It gives short daily practice, asks why you stopped when you do, and suggests changes to your plan. You decide what to accept.
terms.s1_i1: It is not a school or a teacher, and it gives no certificates or grades.
terms.s1_i2: We make no promise about exam results or about the level of Chinese you will reach.
terms.s1_i3: Practice questions are being reviewed by teachers step by step. A question may still contain a mistake. If you find one, please tell us.
terms.s2_i1: Use an e-mail address you control and keep your password private.
terms.s2_i2: One account is for one person. Please do not share it.
terms.s2_i3: You can delete your account at any time in Settings.
terms.s3_p1: The app only proposes changes to your plan. Nothing changes until you confirm. You can accept some, all or none, edit your plan yourself, or rest at any time. Suggestions come from fixed rules. They are not a medical, psychological or educational diagnosis.
terms.s4_title: Free pilot, trial and paid plans
terms.s4_pilot: While the pilot runs, the service is free for everyone. If paid plans start later, we will e-mail you before they apply to you.
terms.s4_billing: New accounts get a {days}-day free trial. After that you need a paid plan. Prices in NT$ are on the Pricing page.
terms.s4_i1: Payments are handled by hand for now: the operator records your payment and extends your access by the length of the plan.
terms.s4_i2: There is no automatic renewal. When your period ends, access to the lessons pauses until you renew. Your data is kept and you can still rest, export or delete it.
terms.s5_i1: Do not try to break, overload or scan the service, or to reach other people's data.
terms.s5_i2: Do not use bots, and do not copy the practice content in bulk to resell it.
terms.s5_i3: We may limit or close accounts that harm the service or other learners. We will explain why where we reasonably can.
terms.s6_p1: The practice material and the design of the app belong to the operator or its authors. You may use them for your own study. You keep ownership of what you write, such as notes, and you allow us to store and process it to run the service.
terms.s7_p1: This is an early service. It may have errors or be unavailable at times. We try to keep it running and to back up data, but we cannot promise that it never fails.
terms.s8_p1: As far as the law allows, the operator is not responsible for indirect losses from using the service. Nothing here limits rights you have under Taiwan consumer protection law that cannot be waived.
terms.s9_p1: We may change these terms. If a change matters, we will e-mail you before it applies.
terms.s10_p1: These terms follow the laws of Taiwan (Republic of China).
